newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Fifth of South African miners on strike - Cosatu.
newsitem.headline: Fifth of South African miners on strike - Cosatu.

text.p: South Africa's Congress of South African Trade Unions (Cosatu) said that 102,000 miners out of an estimated total mining workforce of 500,000 had heeded a one-day general strike call on Monday.
"In the mining sector, a total of 102,000 workers are on strike," a Cosatu spokesperson told Reuters.

Among these, 80,000 workers failed to report for work in the Free State, 10,000 at JCI Ltd's Western Areas Gold Mining Co Ltd and Randfontein Estates Gold Mining Co Ltd mines, and 8,000 at Hartebeestfontein Gold Mining Co Ltd mine.
Cosatu has mobilised for a one-day strike to protest the Basic Conditions of Employment Bill which has already passed through Cabinet and is expected to be tabled before parliament soon.
It is demanding a 40-hour working week, six months maternity leave and double pay for Sunday work.
